_README: Copy to ~/.ripar/mainnet.json and replace the two placeholders. Do NOT commit the result.
merchant.mnemonic is the DEPLOYER. Generate a fresh one in Pera or Defly and
paste it here. Do not reuse a key that has been used on TestNet: those keys
live in plaintext in ~/.ripar/testnet-e2e.json and have signed hundreds of
public transactions.
payer.mnemonic is only needed if you want a second account to act as client
or bidder in a live test. For a deploy alone it can stay as-is.
assetId 31566704 is MainNet USDC (6 decimals). bootstrap writes it ONCE per
app id and it can never be corrected — only redeployed, with new app ids and
every repo repointed. preflight-mainnet.mjs refuses to continue if this is
not 31566704 on a mainnet-v1.0 node.
disputeWindowSecs is also one-shot. 3600 (1h) is the enforced floor on
mainnet; pick the real window you want before deploying, not after.
Then, in this directory:
PREFLIGHT_SCOPE=deploy ALGOD_URL=https://mainnet-api.algonode.cloud \
RIPAR_CONFIG=mainnet.json node preflight-mainnet.mjs <treasuryAddress>
# exit 0 means every irreversible value checked out. Then:
ALGOD_URL=https://mainnet-api.algonode.cloud RIPAR_CONFIG=mainnet.json \
RIPAR_NETWORK=mainnet node deploy-mainnet.mjs
# then prove the chain is running this source:
node verify-deployed.mjs <identityId> <reputationId> <validationId> \
https://mainnet-api.algonode.cloud

merchant.mnemonic: REPLACE WITH A FRESH 25-WORD MAINNET DEPLOYER MNEMONIC

payer.mnemonic: REPLACE OR LEAVE - only needed for a live second-party test
